claim_scope: pinhole back-projection and explicit frame transforms can be validated by an exact projection round trip
observation feedback can reduce fixed actuator-bias error in the deterministic planar-arm fixture
camera optical axes must be explicitly rotated into body axes even when pixel projection round trips exactly
optical-axis z-depth and Euclidean ray range are not interchangeable away from the principal point
a camera-to-body-to-world rigid-transform chain matches its composed transform only after validating proper rotations and applying translation in the target frame

code.config: standard-library v3 RGB-D, proper-rotation, transform-chain, and two-link planar-arm fixtures

data.name: procedural three-pixel RGB-D and planar-arm fixture

limitations: three exact pinhole samples plus one synthetic off-axis ray without lens distortion or missing depth
fixed proper rotations and transforms rather than estimated calibration or localization
kinematic planar arm without contact, inertia, saturation, or timing jitter
demonstrates interface checks rather than real sensor or controller performance
